subject.title: feat(gateway): accept WebSocket request trace context

question: Should OpenClaw expose `traceparent` as a supported long-term Gateway WebSocket request-frame field, rather than keeping upstream trace correlation outside the Gateway protocol?
rationale: The implementation is additive, but it expands the public Gateway protocol and native client contracts; tests establish mechanics but cannot decide the permanent product/API boundary.

options.title: Adopt the request-scoped protocol field
options.body: Accept `traceparent` as optional observability metadata after live proof confirms authenticated request isolation and the contract remains explicitly documented.

options.title: Keep tracing client-side
options.body: Reject the new Gateway field and preserve the existing fresh-root request behavior if permanent protocol expansion is not desired.

recommendation.title: Adopt the request-scoped protocol field
recommendation.body: Accept `traceparent` as optional observability metadata after live proof confirms authenticated request isolation and the contract remains explicitly documented.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and authored the latest Gateway isolation coverage.
